overall: No violation found. The notice listed "Interviews/Recreation Coordinator" and met the statutory topic requirements on its face. The complaint was filed before the meeting occurred. The AG added a reminder that interview notices should name candidates the body knows 48 hours ahead, but that candidate addresses need not be listed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice for an October 21, 2014 meeting failed to list the names and addresses of recreation coordinator candidates to be interviewed.
